_about: Ouida's (1839-1908) stories for children: Bimbi (The Nürnberg Stove, The Ambitious Rose Tree, Lampblack, Bandita, The Child of Urbino, Findelkind), A Dog of Flanders, The Nürnberg Stove, and Other Stories, and Moufflou and Other Stories (Lippincott 1910). The single-story books are held inside these collections. She died in 1908, so every edition is public domain. Her adult novels are left out. Added at the coordinator's standing relay (2026-10-02/03: choose public-domain storytellers batches; Adam may veto).
